title: Jalapeño’s first results show industry-leading speed and efficiency in AI inference
summary: OpenAI发布了其定制推理芯片Jalapeño的首批结果，该芯片在AI推理方面实现了行业领先的速度和效率，为现代模型提供了更高的吞吐量和更低的延迟。
highlights: Jalapeño is a custom inference chip from OpenAI
delivers faster, more power-efficient AI inference
higher throughput and lower latency for modern models
